stepAnswer: B: bias increases as lambda increases, growing steeply and unboundedly
stepBody: Which of the following could plausibly be a plot of the magnitude (i.e., absolute value) of model bias as a function of λ if we use multiple linear regression with exponential regularization? Assume that values on the x-axis are linear from $$0$$ to asymptotically large λ. Circle the letter corresponding to the most plausible plot.\n\n[See plots A, B, C, D in the exam.]##figure1.gif##
choices: A: bias decreases then levels off as lambda increases
B: bias increases as lambda increases, growing steeply and unboundedly
C: bias decreases monotonically as lambda increases
D: bias increases then decreases as lambda increases
E: bias remains constant as lambda increases
